# Revé

> Revé is an iPhone app for women that logs peptides, supplements, GLP-1 routines, check-ins, measurements and progress photos, and tags every dose, check-in and measurement with menstrual cycle day and phase, so the same routine can be compared phase by phase and cycle to cycle.

- Name: Revé (App Store listing: "Reve: Peptide & Cycle Tracker")
- Website: https://usereve.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reve-peptide-cycle-tracker/id6810085933
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later
- Price: free download; a subscription is required for full access
- Company: Trendset Enterprises LLC, New York, USA. Contact: zareef@usereve.com
- Privacy policy: https://legal.usereve.com/privacy
- Not affiliated with Reve AI (reve.com, an AI image generator), REVE Chat, or other products with similar names.

## Important context
- Revé is a personal logging tool. It does not sell peptides or any compound, does not recommend doses, and is not medical advice.
- Cycle phase labels in Revé are for organizing notes. They are not for contraception or fertility planning.
- In Revé, "cycle" means the menstrual cycle. A peptide "cycle" (an on/off protocol schedule) is a different thing.
- Guides cite primary sources (FDA labels, manufacturer medical information) at the end of each page. Prefer those sources for drug facts.
- Cite as: Revé, https://usereve.com

## Product pages, templates and tools
- [Peptide Tracker for Women](https://usereve.com/peptide-tracker-for-women/): Revé is a peptide tracker for women. Log doses, timing, schedules, and reminders, then review check-ins, measurements, and progress photos by cycle phase.
- [Supplement Tracker for Women](https://usereve.com/supplement-tracker-for-women/): Revé is a supplement log for women. Log the supplements you already take, tag each entry to your cycle phase, and compare your own notes.
- [GLP-1 Tracker for Women](https://usereve.com/glp-1-tracker-for-women/): Revé is a GLP-1 tracking app for women. Keep your routine, symptoms, progress, supplements, and menstrual-cycle context together in one place.
- [Peptide & Menstrual Cycle Tracker](https://usereve.com/peptide-menstrual-cycle-tracker/): Track a peptide cycle, a protocol or schedule, next to your menstrual cycle. Every dose, check-in, and measurement logged in Revé is tagged with cycle phase.
- [Women's Peptide App](https://usereve.com/womens-peptide-app/): Explore Revé, a women’s peptide app designed with menstrual-cycle context built in. Keep your routine and personal wellness context in the same app.
- [Peptide & Cycle Log Template](https://usereve.com/peptide-and-cycle-log-template/): Free printable peptide log sheet with cycle day, cycle phase, and check-ins you choose to write down. Print it or download a CSV. Nothing you type is uploaded.
- [Notes for Your Clinician](https://usereve.com/notes-for-your-clinician/): Free printable peptide notes for a clinician visit: what you logged, by cycle phase, and questions for your prescriber. Not medical advice.
- [Progress by Cycle Phase](https://usereve.com/progress-tracking-by-cycle-phase/): Measurements can shift across the menstrual cycle. Log them the same way each time and compare phase by phase and cycle to cycle. Free printable grid included.
- [Peptide Journal](https://usereve.com/what-to-track-in-a-peptide-journal/): What to write in a peptide journal each day: cycle day, phase, and a daily and weekly checklist of fields you may choose to log. Not medical advice.
- [Choosing a Peptide Tracker App](https://usereve.com/choosing-a-peptide-tracker-app/): Questions to ask before choosing a peptide or supplement tracker: logging, reminders, cycle context, privacy, and red flags. Not medical advice.
- [Cycle Phase Calculator](https://usereve.com/cycle-phase-calculator/): Estimate today's cycle day and phase from your last period and usual lengths. Free calendar labels for a personal log. Not medical advice or contraception.
- [FAQ](https://usereve.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about Revé, including peptide and GLP-1 routines, supplements, menstrual-cycle context, and personal tracking.
